findings.title: Content images carry no text alternative, hiding any fact they display
findings.evidence:
Observed at https://www.accenture.com/en via image_alt_coverage_inspection [2026-09-13T15:41:25Z]: 10 of 12 images (83%) have no alt attribute at all (images correctly marked decorative with alt="" are excluded). Any figure, price, spec or claim rendered inside those images is unreadable to a retrieval bot. (Confidence: high)
Additional evidence (crawl-render-audit): Observed at https://www.accenture.com/en/about/reinvention-services via image_alt_coverage_inspection [2026-09-13T15:41:25Z]: 20 of 21 images (95%) have no alt attribute at all (images correctly marked decorative with alt="" are excluded). Any figure, price, spec or claim rendered inside those images is unreadable to a retrieval bot. (Confidence: high)
Additional evidence (crawl-render-audit): Observed at https://www.accenture.com/en/insights/strategy/reinvented-with-accenture via image_alt_coverage_inspection [2026-09-13T15:41:25Z]: 10 of 11 images (91%) have no alt attribute at all (images correctly marked decorative with alt="" are excluded). Any figure, price, spec or claim rendered inside those images is unreadable to a retrieval bot. (Confidence: high)
Additional evidence (crawl-render-audit): Observed at https://www.accenture.com/en?country=ae via image_alt_coverage_inspection [2026-09-13T15:41:25Z]: 10 of 12 images (83%) have no alt attribute at all (images correctly marked decorative with alt="" are excluded). Any figure, price, spec or claim rendered inside those images is unreadable to a retrieval bot. (Confidence: high)

suggested_action.summary: Add descriptive alt text to every image that carries information.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Give each informational image an alt attribute stating the fact it conveys ("Pro plan: $49 per user per month"), not a filename. Mark purely decorative images with alt="" so they are correctly skipped rather than left unlabelled.
suggested_action.expected_benefit: Improves fact extractability by making the observed information clearer and more extractable for the intended audience.

evidence_details.observation: 10 of 12 images (83%) have no alt attribute at all (images correctly marked decorative with alt="" are excluded). Any figure, price, spec or claim rendered inside those images is unreadable to a retrieval bot.

findings.severity_rationale: Rated medium because the observed evidence indicates medium impact; unavailable evidence is not treated as a defect.

findings.title: No extractable answer on-site for "How much does Reinvented with Accenture cost?"
findings.evidence: Observed at https://www.accenture.com/en via onsite_answerability_probe [2026-09-13T15:41:42Z]: Across 5 crawled page(s), no price, currency or pricing language is extractable from the crawled text. An assistant that fetched these pages could not quote an answer to "How much does Reinvented with Accenture cost?" from this site, so it must fall back to third-party sources or omit the brand. (Confidence: medium)

suggested_action.summary: Make pricing extractable as text, not just as an image or a gated flow.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: State prices in plain HTML text and add Offer JSON-LD with price and priceCurrency. If pricing is genuinely quote-only, say so explicitly in text -- an assistant can cite "pricing is quote-based" but cannot cite silence.
suggested_action.expected_benefit: Improves citation omission by making the observed information clearer and more extractable for the intended audience.

evidence_details.observation: Across 5 crawled page(s), no price, currency or pricing language is extractable from the crawled text. An assistant that fetched these pages could not quote an answer to "How much does Reinvented with Accenture cost?" from this site, so it must fall back to third-party sources or omit the brand.

findings.severity_rationale: Rated medium because the observed evidence indicates medium impact; unavailable evidence is not treated as a defect.

findings.title: No site search affordance found on any crawled page
findings.evidence: Observed at https://www.accenture.com via search_affordance_detection [2026-09-13T15:41:25Z]: None of the 5 crawled pages expose a search input, a search form or role="search". A visitor who arrives on the wrong page from an AI answer has no way to find the right one without returning to the assistant. (Confidence: medium)

suggested_action.summary: Add a site search box to the persistent header.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Add a search input in the global header and expose it with role="search". Add WebSite JSON-LD with a potentialAction SearchAction so assistants can surface your search directly.
suggested_action.expected_benefit: Improves navigation by making the observed information clearer and more extractable for the intended audience.

findings.title: No returning-visitor or account affordance detected
findings.evidence: Observed at https://www.accenture.com via returning_visitor_affordance_detection [2026-09-13T15:41:25Z]: Across 5 crawled pages there is no sign-in, account, saved-items or recently-viewed affordance in the visible text. Every visitor is therefore treated as anonymous and first-time, so nothing the brand already knows about a returning visitor can shape what they are shown. (Confidence: medium)

suggested_action.summary: Give returning visitors a way to be recognised, and use it.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Add an account or saved-state affordance appropriate to the site (sign-in, saved items, recently viewed, or a lightweight preference stored locally), then use it to surface relevant content on return rather than resetting every visitor to a cold start.
suggested_action.expected_benefit: Improves personalization readiness by making the observed information clearer and more extractable for the intended audience.

assessments.reason: robots.txt was fetched and its rules were applied to page and link fetches.
Initial HTML was inspected for shell signals; no browser rendering was used.
Answerability was checked against accessible on-site text and structured data only.
Only explicitly linked authority domains were inspected; external sources were not fabricated or searched.

proactive_recommendations.title: Restructure long pages so each section answers one question on its own
proactive_recommendations.rationale: 2 crawled page(s) carry long runs of prose with few headings to break them up. Retrieval systems lift a passage out of its surroundings; a section that only makes sense after the paragraphs above it cannot be quoted safely, so it tends not to be quoted at all. Self-contained, answer-first sections under sequential headings are consistently the most citable shape.

suggested_action.summary: Break long pages into self-contained sections that lead with the answer.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Give each section a heading phrased the way a user would ask the question, then open with the answer in the first sentence and support it below. Keep paragraphs to two to four sentences and keep the heading hierarchy sequential (h1 -> h2 -> h3, no skipped levels).

proactive_recommendations.title: Declare a WebSite entity with SearchAction
proactive_recommendations.rationale: No WebSite schema was found. WebSite ties the domain to the brand entity and, with a potentialAction SearchAction, lets assistants point users straight into your own search instead of guessing at URLs. It is a small, stable addition that anchors everything else on the page to a named site.

suggested_action.summary: Add WebSite JSON-LD with a SearchAction pointing at your search endpoint.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Add WebSite JSON-LD on the homepage with name, url, a publisher reference to your Organization @id, and potentialAction -> SearchAction with a target URL template.

proactive_recommendations.title: State AI usage terms explicitly in robots.txt
proactive_recommendations.rationale: robots.txt names which agents may crawl but says nothing about what may be done with the content once fetched. Emerging conventions -- Cloudflare's Content Signals Policy (released CC0) and RSL licensing terms -- let a publisher separate training use from search indexing and answer generation in machine-readable form, instead of leaving that distinction to be inferred from which user agents happen to be listed.

suggested_action.summary: Add machine-readable content-usage signals to robots.txt.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Add a Content Signals Policy block declaring your position on search, ai-input and ai-train separately, or publish RSL licensing terms. Keep it consistent with the agents you actually allow, or the two signals will contradict each other.

proactive_recommendations.title: Expose an agent-facing endpoint (NLWeb / MCP) built on existing structured data
proactive_recommendations.rationale: The site already publishes structured data, which is the input NLWeb uses to serve a conversational endpoint that AI agents can query directly rather than scraping HTML. Because it builds on schema.org markup, sitemaps and feeds you already maintain, it is incremental rather than a rebuild, and it moves the brand from being read by agents to being queryable by them.

suggested_action.summary: Evaluate an NLWeb instance exposing an /ask and /mcp endpoint over existing content.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Point an NLWeb instance at your existing schema.org data and sitemap, and expose /ask and /mcp. Start with the content an agent is most likely to be asked about -- catalogue, docs, pricing.

proactive_recommendations.title: Consider publishing llms.txt, with realistic expectations
proactive_recommendations.rationale: No /llms.txt is published. Be aware this is a low-evidence convention rather than an established standard: 2026 measurements find major AI crawlers almost never request the file, and Google has stated it has no effect on Search or AI Overviews. It costs very little to publish and may matter if uptake improves, but it should be treated as optionality -- not as a substitute for the structured data and third-party presence that demonstrably drive citation today.

suggested_action.summary: Optionally publish /llms.txt, after the higher-leverage items above.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: If you publish one, keep it to a short markdown index of your canonical product, docs, pricing and company pages, and keep it in sync with the site. Do not deprioritise schema work for it.
